items.title: Eli Lilly Has a $100 Billion Revenue Story in the Making, 18% Upside Ahead
items.summary: Eli Lilly just crossed a $1 trillion market cap for the first time, and management is already pointing toward a milestone that would rewrite the drugmaker's history. Whether three converging pipeline catalysts can justify the valuation is the question every investor needs to answer now.

items.title: Can Eli Lilly Keep The Margin You Are Now Paying For?
items.summary: The share of every sales dollar Eli Lilly keeps as operating profit has roughly doubled against its own long-run record, and it is volume rather than price holding it there.

items.title: Amgen Touches 52-Week High: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: AMGN's strong growth drivers and promising pipeline support long-term growth, but patent losses, pricing pressure and valuation warrant caution.

items.title: Stock Market News for Aug 24, 2026
items.summary: U.S. stocks closed higher on Friday following a massive sell-off in the previous session, driven by a sharp rise in bond yields, while a lack of clarity over the progress in the Middle East kept denting investors' morale.

items.title: FDA Approves Alzheimer’s Blood Test Developed by Roche and Eli Lilly
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration cleared a blood test for identifying Alzheimer’s disease symptoms, which was developed by Roche and Eli Lilly.

items.title: Eli Lilly Launches Foundayo Weight-Loss Pill in U.K.
items.summary: The once-daily pill was approved for patients with a body mass index of at least 30, or between 27 and 30 in the event of at least one weight-related health condition.
